flags: minor: 'positive integers n from 1 through 9' is slightly wordy; 'integers n with 1 ≤ n ≤ 9' is cleaner
B007-01.notes: n^2 has exactly 3 divisors iff n is prime: 2+3+5+7=17. 18 adds 1 (1 has 1 divisor); 45 is sum 1-9.

B007-03.notes: Discriminant 36-4c>0 gives c<9; vertex x=3>1 so both roots >1 iff f(1)=c-5>0. Hence 5<c<9.

B007-04.notes: Rate (17-9.5)/3=2.5 cm/h; initial height 17+5=22; 22/2.5=8.8 h. 3.8 = additional time after hour 5.

B007-05.notes: f^-1(x)=(2x+1)/(x-3), undefined at x=3 (horizontal asymptote of f / value not in range). 2 is f's excluded input trap.

B007-07.notes: Inscribed angle BAC intercepts arc BC, so arc = 2*28=56. 62 is angle ABC trap; 124 is arc AC.

B007-08.notes: Sorted a,b,8,d,e; 10 must appear twice so d=e=10; sum 35 gives a+b=7 with a<b<8 distinct (no tie): (1,6),(2,5),(3,4) -> 3. Brute-force confirms 3.

B007-09.notes: 1350 sq ft = 150 sq yd; /10 = 15 rolls (exact, no rounding). 135 = forgetting conversion (1350/10).

B007-10.notes: Time 12/8+12/24=1.5+0.5=2 h; 24/2=12 km/h. 16 is the arithmetic-mean trap.
